title: Velo is a desktop Gmail client built with Rust and Tauri. Emails sync to local SQLite — no servers
description:
Velo is a desktop Gmail client built with Rust and Tauri. Emails sync to local SQLite — no servers, full offline access, instant startup, low memory. Keyboard-first with Superhuman-style shortcuts and a command palette. AI integration (Claude, GPT, Gemini) for thread summaries, smart replies, and inbox search, all cached locally. Smart inbox with auto-categorization, snooze, schedule send, undo send, and follow-up reminders.

https://github.com/avihaymenahem/velo
